description: This file defines the Hyperlinks class responsible for reading and setting hyperlink data in XLSX worksheets within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles parsing of hyperlink relationships and associates URLs, tooltips, and references to worksheet cells.

classes.name: Hyperlinks
classes.description: Class responsible for reading and setting hyperlink information in XLSX worksheet objects, including parsing relationship XML and assigning URLs/tooltips to worksheet cells.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Hyperlinks object with a specific Worksheet.

methods.name: readHyperlinks
methods.description: Reads hyperlink relationship data from an XML element and stores the hyperlinks.

methods.name: setHyperlinks
methods.description: Sets hyperlinks for the worksheet based on the worksheet XML.

methods.name: setHyperlink
methods.description: Assigns a hyperlink URL and tooltip to worksheet cells based on the hyperlink XML element.
